title: Trajectory Equation in Phase Plane
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the Cartesian equation of the trajectories for dx/dt = -y, dy/dt = x.
finalAnswer: x^2 + y^2 = C \quad (\text{Family of concentric circles})

steps.title: Separate Variables and Integrate
steps.mathExpression: y \, dy = -x \, dx \implies \int y \, dy = -\int x \, dx \implies \frac{y^2}{2} = -\frac{x^2}{2} + C' \implies x^2 + y^2 = C
steps.explanation: Circular orbits centered at the origin.
